home.intro: The Oasis is planned as a persistent community hub: start in a central Hub, discover worlds others have made, personalize an avatar and Home, or create worlds of your own. Visitors won't need to code.
home.now: The public product foundation is verified. Sign-in, playable spaces and online services are not live.

pillars.title: Arrive together
pillars.detail: A new account will create or select an avatar and start in the central Hub, with a launch dashboard available to find a next step.

pillars.title: Make it yours
pillars.detail: A player will control their avatar and outfit, open a personal Home, and carry their choices between compatible worlds.

pillars.title: Explore and create
pillars.detail: Find worlds made by the community or build one with code. Visitors can explore without programming; creator tools are one path inside the larger Oasis.

project.next: F1 is verified. Application implementation has not started; S1 remains planned until the owner authorizes a separate scope. The proposed local proof covers a Hub/dashboard, player-owned appearance, optional Home, two original worlds, exact confirmed-location resume, recoverable saves, and an independently stoppable interpreted runtime with bounded host commands and hostile-case tests.

progress.intro: The F1 product foundation is verified in public. The application has not started. Here is the completed foundation work with evidence you can inspect.

roadmap.intro: The Oasis has a broad journey: establish a clear product foundation, prove the local experience, then earn each online capability with its own evidence. No dates or percentages are promised.

community.intro: The Oasis is being shaped in public, one careful step at a time. You can help with research, accessibility, architecture or documentation before a playable application exists.
